author: Praxis II
title: Recommended DAQB (EID 609) via shared module
abstract: Run the recommended Human Heart configuration by importing a public shared module: storage/shared/algorithms/daqb_recommended.py. This provides a clean, lineage-agnostic reference implementation of EtC→BRBG→DAQB (δ=0.15, k_density=20, k=48, cosine; binary edges + true distances; column balancing).
